thesis.final_decision: whether to submit a request for separate explicit economic authorization (Issue #810) to seal and launch attempt 2 of the frozen carry_paper_screen_v2 prospective paper screen; this packet authorizes no seal, launch, storage probe, network access or economic run
thesis.hypothesis: A matched BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT spot-long / USD-M perpetual-short carry with fixed monthly equal-quantity targets (gross 0.5, common lot 0.001, irreversible 10% drawdown stop), executed only against later recorded depth under the declared fees and adverse-price assumptions, earns positive net virtual-USDT profit above recorded fees over a fresh ninety-day prospective window, positive in each of three thirty-day blocks, with nonzero funding receipts in every block, while staying flat at the terminal close. Any reused 2023-2024 development replay of the same fixed family is reused-development evidence only and is not evidence for the prospective window; no development economic outcome is recorded in this packet.
thesis.economic_mechanism: When the perpetual funding rate is positive, long perpetual holders pay short holders at each published settlement; a spot-long / perpetual-short pair of equal quantity hedges price exposure and collects the funding transfer, net of two-venue taker fees, depth-limited adverse fills and basis or hedge-break risk. Decision chain as implemented: source = unauthenticated public GET market data from the official Binance spot and USD-M hosts (100-level depth, mark/index, published funding history, venue clocks, exchange rules), preserved as raw bytes with SHA-256; availability = local request-start/receipt UTC times, five-second source-age and ten-second decision-to-execution limits, receipt-time-only disclosure for spot depth, settlement-time funding assignment; feature_state = observed prices, realized quantities, equity and drawdown on the canonical BookState; model_strategy = FundingCarryBot monthly matched-quantity targets, no forecast and no learned selector; intent = signed integer-lot target per instrument with at most one order per instrument per observation; order = a saved decision followed by a later quote capture; fill = the provider-independent recorded-depth executor consuming at most 10% of displayed size, partial fills retained, no atomic two-leg assumption; accounting = the single canonical BookState with signed principal, one-time fees and funding on the position held strictly before each settlement; evidence = append-only protocol-bound journal, sealed source/runtime identity and the offline replay at the deadline; decision = the frozen screen evaluated once, offline, after close plus the 180-second grace.
thesis.counter_hypothesis: Positive paper profit, if any, is explained by something other than a repeatable carry edge: selection of the carry family on already-seen 2023-2024 development data; the single ninety-day regime; optimistic fill assumptions (10% of displayed depth, fixed 5bp adverse buffer, no queue position or latency, receipt-time-only spot depth); mark-to-mid valuation of the spot leg; funding-rate compression; or an operational artifact such as a gap, asynchronous funding publication or an unmatched hedge. Equally, a rejected screen may reflect an operational failure of the collector rather than the absence of carry.
thesis.information_gain: One causal, fresh, write-once ninety-day window can falsify the hypothesis: a rejected frozen screen is a valid failed-hypothesis outcome. A pass shows only that this one window met the frozen criteria under paper assumptions. It cannot show an edge at larger capital, under venue account rules, in other regimes, or live.
thesis.cheapest_falsifier: For the software and mechanism claim, the offline synthetic Decimal reference ledger (tests/evaluation/paper_ledger_oracle.py) and the sealing, lineage and assessment tests already exist and run without network access or data. For the economic hypothesis there is no cheaper falsifier than the frozen screen itself, run once on fresh data; opening unused or additional data to pre-test it is forbidden. Before any seal, the storage probe is the cheapest capacity falsifier (it is not run by this packet and needs its own Issue #810 authorization).
thesis.stop_rule: Do not seal, launch or run the storage probe without both (a) an independent research_assurance_v1 review of this exact digest and exact heads from a different authenticated GitHub principal and (b) explicit user authorization on Issue #810. Operator-authorization evidence for (b): https://github.com/shuntatsu/trade_rl/issues/810#issuecomment-6659653178 (posted 2026-11-05 under the owner's GitHub account, recorded by the planner relaying the owner's chat instructions; the owner can edit or revoke it; the comment names no UTC start time, so one must still be chosen and recorded at plan and seal; code can check only the URL shape, not that the comment exists or says what it should). The comment is authorization evidence only and does not substitute for (a). After sealing, any collection-failure.json, observation gap over 180 seconds, unmatched hedge, drawdown at or above 10%, late, missing, revised or out-of-order funding settlement, changed source or runtime identity, clock reversal or single source error ends the attempt: no resume, repair, retry or backfill. A failed screen is not rescued by changing criteria, window, symbols, costs, fee assumptions, participation or the stop level, and is not reinterpreted from partial profit. A further attempt needs a new lineage, review and seal. If the economic screen is rejected, stop this configuration of the carry line rather than tuning it on the same evidence.
thesis.metric_proxy_rationale: Net marked virtual-USDT equity change against the declared zero-interest cash comparison, on the canonical ledger with once-charged fees, depth-based adverse fills, funding by published settlement time and actual simulated exits, requiring positive net profit, positive return in each thirty-day block, net profit above recorded fees, observed maximum drawdown below 10% and funding receipts in every block. It is a paper proxy: minute sampling is not an intraminute drawdown or liquidity guarantee, and fee headroom is assessed on the realized trajectory rather than a recomputed doubled-fee strategy.
thesis.limitations: This packet describes the existing frozen carry_paper_screen_v2 plan and the attempt-2 lineage exactly as implemented and changes no criterion. The owner's verbatim words of 2026-11-05 (per https://github.com/shuntatsu/trade_rl/issues/810#issuecomment-6659653178) were "別アカウントによるレビュー　別になんでもいいよ。agyのレビューでいいよ", which say that the reviewing account does not matter and that a review through Antigravity (agy, Gemini) is acceptable; they do not name the same GitHub account. This packet is UNREVIEWED and makes no PASS claim. The user statement attests only that the attempt-1 data and result locations are unknown and that new data may be collected; it does not attest the lineage values or the absence of an earlier attempt, and global attempt uniqueness stays unestablished. G0 predecessor verification is not performed for attempt 2 and is not claimed: it is recorded as not_established for the four listed items, under the bounded predecessor-root-unavailable path defined in docs/architecture/research-assurance.md (lineage v3, --predecessor-root-status unavailable). That path applies only to attempt 2 of this family whose attempt-1 evidence root is unavailable, and it does not apply generally. No screen criterion is relaxed. Threat model: the seal, launch and collector gates (attempt2, paper.cli, seal_paper_study, seal_collection, PaperEngine, PaperCollector) prevent accidental or non-canonical records through the supported entry points; they are not authentication against a malicious local operator, who can edit code or files, and they do not defend against objects that override dunder methods, monkeypatching, private internals or edits to sealed roots. The module-private seal token is a caller contract, not a credential. Paper trading establishes no queue position, latency, venue account rules, larger-capital liquidity, intraminute risk, production eligibility or live safety. The per-instrument rules are current-metadata snapshots valid for at most one hour. Software CI, a successful source probe and any development replay are not forward economic evidence. No economic result of any attempt-1 or attempt-2 observation was read to write this packet.

authorities.sign: signed principal to cash, fees charged once and always as cost, funding applied to the signed quantity held strictly before the settlement timestamp (long pays and short receives a positive rate)
authorities.risk: FundingCarryBot irreversible 10% drawdown stop, permanent stop on hedge mismatch, collateral and insolvency checks applied before newly known funding is credited, frozen close time as a permanent zero target

unit.statement: Every order is a signed integer-lot quantity admitted by the intersection of venue LOT_SIZE and MARKET_LOT_SIZE, minimum notional and maximum rules; depth capacity is the exact decimal sum across levels before the lot quantum is applied, and an unmatched residual is never rounded into a fictitious flat account.
unit.counterexample: Many small depth levels that each round to zero lots, an order below minimum notional or off the lot grid, a disabled zero market step, and a residual quantity on one leg after an asymmetric partial fill.
unit.oracle: tests/simulation/test_depth_execution.py, tests/integrations/test_binance_forward_rules.py and the literal Decimal quantities of tests/evaluation/paper_ledger_oracle.py with tests/evaluation/test_paper_ledger_oracle.py, which compare positions with declared target quantities rather than with production rounding.
unit.known_limitations: Venue-specific averaged notional checks and account-specific restrictions are not modeled by the depth primitive; current rule metadata cannot authorize orders and is valid for at most one hour; synthetic fixtures do not prove real venue acceptance.

time.statement: A decision uses only information received before it; execution uses only a quote captured after the saved decision, no older than five seconds at receipt and executed within ten seconds of the decision; funding is assigned to a block by published settlement timestamp in [start, close) and not by receipt time; observations may not have a gap over 180 seconds.
time.counterexample: A quote received before the decision, a stale or future-dated source timestamp, a pending decision executed after its ten-second lifetime, funding settled after close but received during the grace window, a clock reversal, and a 181-second gap.
time.oracle: tests/simulation/test_depth_execution.py, tests/integrations/test_binance_forward.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_engine.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_assessment.py (causal block marks, settlement-time funding blocks, post-close funding) and the funding-timing cases of tests/evaluation/test_paper_ledger_oracle.py, which hold a position first filled at the settlement timestamp out of that payment.
time.known_limitations: Spot REST depth has no exchange timestamp, so its freshness rests on receipt time only; the conservative out-of-order funding rule can reject ordinary asynchronous publication; synthetic causality does not prove historical or future vendor availability.

state.statement: All quantities, cash and pending intent come from realized fills committed to the protocol-bound hash-chained journal; a restart resumes exactly once, a failed append cannot mutate the running account, a gap cancels pending intent and preserves holdings, and no half-published event becomes an executed fill.
state.counterexample: Appending from a stale parent, reusing an idempotency key with different content, an interrupted transaction, a hot rollback journal, a restart after a crash mid-cycle, and a forged or non-canonical protocol.json.
state.oracle: tests/evaluation/test_paper_journal.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_engine.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_engine_replay_memory.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_control.py, and the restart and replay comparison of tests/evaluation/test_paper_ledger_oracle.py, which recompute state from literal events.
state.known_limitations: These tests cover the supported entry points only; a local operator who edits the database or sealed root is out of scope; journal replay latency and memory on a ninety-day journal are operator-measured and not established offline.

sign.statement: Buys reduce and sells increase cash by signed principal; fees always reduce equity and are charged once; funding credits or debits the signed quantity held strictly before the settlement time, so a short perpetual receives a positive rate and a long pays it; a later credit must not hide an earlier debit's drawdown or collateral breach.
sign.counterexample: A position opened at the same timestamp as a settlement, a negative funding rate on the short leg, simultaneous settlements netting a debit against a credit, and a settlement at the retry timestamp that must use only the earlier partial holding.
sign.oracle: tests/evaluation/paper_ledger_oracle.py, an independent Decimal reference that imports no production accounting, strategy or depth helper, compared in tests/evaluation/test_paper_ledger_oracle.py for cash, quantities, fees, funding and equity.
sign.known_limitations: Synthetic fixtures with literal events only; the reference does not parse raw capture bytes or exchange-rule metadata and does not establish liquidation conformance or real funding publication behavior.

risk.statement: The carry bot stops permanently at a 10% drawdown; a hedge mismatch after all four leg attempts permanently stops new exposure; collateral, insolvency and drawdown are checked before newly known funding is credited and after each chronological settlement group; the screen requires observed drawdown below 10%, no nonterminal stop and actual terminal flatness.
risk.counterexample: A drawdown of exactly 10%, a delayed positive funding payment that would undo an earlier breach, an asymmetric partial fill, an unpaid announced settlement, and a stop that occurs between decision and execution.
risk.oracle: tests/strategies/test_carry.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_engine.py, tests/evaluation/test_paper_assessment.py (screen_reasons drawdown, not-flat, nonterminal-stop and unpaid-funding checks) and the asymmetric-partial and terminal-close cases of tests/evaluation/test_paper_ledger_oracle.py.
risk.known_limitations: Minute sampling is not an intraminute drawdown or liquidity guarantee; the 10% stop is stricter than the user's 20% research ceiling and does not prove a larger account meets 20%; complete liquidation, margin and venue-risk conformance are not established.

execution.statement: A fill uses the correct book side and at most 10% of displayed size, charges the recorded weighted price plus a fixed 5bp adverse buffer and the declared taker fee once without separately charging the quoted spread, retains partial fills, and never assumes an atomic two-leg exchange fill or fills a missing quote from a later observation.
execution.counterexample: An order larger than 10% of displayed capacity, a thin book where only one leg fills, an empty or crossed book, and a missing quote followed by a later observation.
execution.oracle: tests/simulation/test_depth_execution.py and the capacity-limited fills, adverse prices and fee-once checks that tests/evaluation/paper_ledger_oracle.py derives from displayed depth independently of simulation/depth.py.
execution.known_limitations: No queue position, latency, market impact beyond 10% of displayed depth, order rejection or venue-specific order behavior is modeled; the 10% participation, 5bp adverse and fee levels are paper assumptions, not measured venue costs.

accounting.statement: There is one financial ledger (the canonical BookState); the paper engine neither adds another ledger nor reads reported fills, fees or account metrics as oracle inputs; cash, positions, marks, equity, peak, drawdown, fees, turnover, funding and futures collateral agree with the separate reference, and a terminal request is complete only after actual fills leave no position or pending decision.
accounting.counterexample: Valuing existing positions at a transient fill price to manufacture an equity peak, counting a funding payment twice, charging a fee twice, and treating a terminal intent as flat before the closing fills.
accounting.oracle: tests/evaluation/test_paper_ledger_oracle.py comparing the engine with tests/evaluation/paper_ledger_oracle.py over entry, partial completion, funding and terminal close; the reference carries its own no-production-import check (test_oracle_has_no_production_accounting_or_strategy_imports).
accounting.known_limitations: This is synthetic software coverage of the four-instrument paper ledger; it does not establish full source-to-ledger conformance, formal G2 approval, real-feed behavior or economic performance.

evidence.statement: The sealed protocol binds the fixed carry_paper_screen_v2 plan (ninety days, three thirty-day blocks, zero-interest cash comparison, positive net profit and positive return in each block, net profit above recorded fees, drawdown below 10%, nonzero funding in each block, one fill in each of BTC spot, BTC perpetual, ETH spot and ETH perpetual, actual flatness, production_eligible false), the attempt-2 lineage v3 with predecessor_root unavailable, and the source and runtime digests; evaluation audits the externally pinned final tip, every raw source, every completed cycle and the exact source roster, and a partial, short or altered-duration run cannot qualify. The storage probe is the only networked step before launch, writes to a new scratch root outside the repository and any sealed root, is never an attempt, and its conservative bytes-per-observation rate must show that the 129,604-slot screen fits free space with the plan's 1.25 headroom, otherwise seal refuses.
evidence.counterexample: An attempt-2 record sealed under a v2 label or with a forged v3 token or non-canonical predecessor_root, a protocol altered after seal, an early evaluation with a pinned empty tip, a profitable short run relabelled as a study, a post-close nonzero funding settlement, a missing instrument fill, and a probe root fed to seal, launch, run, supervise or evaluate.
evidence.known_limitations: The lineage fields remain caller assertions and the seal-token gate is a caller contract, not authentication against a malicious local operator; the predecessor protocol digest, tip, gap and the absence of an earlier unreported attempt are not_established because the attempt-1 root is lost; the storage probe has not been run; a pass is one ninety-day paper window and never implies production eligibility, live trading or an economic authorization beyond this research record.

evidence.independent_reconstruction: Software-level only. tests/evaluation/paper_ledger_oracle.py is a separate Decimal reference calculation that imports no production accounting, strategy or depth helper and never uses reported fills, fees or metrics as inputs, and the offline paper evaluate command rebuilds the account from the journal and raw sources without trusting stored decision booleans. The booleans in this evidence section describe evidence established so far for this packet, not the intended design: they are true only where the frozen screen enforces the property in software and tests (common_accounting, hard_risk, terminal_state, multi_symbol, no_development_rescue) and false where the property needs prospective observation or is a paper assumption not established here (point_in_time for real feeds, realistic_costs beyond declared paper assumptions, fit_development_unused_separated for a sealed prospective window, multi_period for a single ninety-day window). No prospective observation has been collected for this packet, and a full independent source-to-ledger replay is not established.
